Subject: Pilot: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing options

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo this week — our engineering and SRE leads were impressed with the latency and the KV cache behavior. We're putting together a short procurement packet and need a clean set of options for your observability add-ons: retention for logs/ops telemetry, tracing retention (span storage), and the advanced dashboards product (seat or per-embed pricing).

Questions we need answered for procurement:
- A clear 3-tier pricing matrix for retention (30/90/365 days) with per-GB month rates and an example monthly bill for our current ingestion (I attached a rough ingestion estimate).
- Tracing retention options and whether you charge by ingested spans or stored GB — we want the simplest predictable model.
- Dashboard license model: per-seat vs per-embed vs unlimited under a bundle.
- Any standard early-adopter or pilot credits you can extend — our procurement asks for at least one committed-month credit to offset onboarding.

Can you get this over by Monday? Procurement is looking to slot the pilot in December if pricing looks reasonable.

Appreciate it,
Amy
Amy Li
Head of Platform Engineering
Telestack

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Hi Amy — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the ingest estimate. Putting high level options below and attaching a one-page proposal (Trace-SLA-Proposal-v2.pdf) with examples based on your numbers. Ben and Laura are looped in for the rate card and contract language.

Summary options (high level):
1) Starter retention bundle — 30d logs + 14d traces
   - Retention: $0.085 / GB-month
   - Tracing: $0.045 / ingested-span-equivalent (approx $0.80 / GB-month)
   - Dashboards: $25 / editor seat, $120 / dashboard embed per month
   - Good for pilots; includes 14-day onboarding credit (waive first 2 weeks of retention fees)

2) Production retention bundle — 90d logs + 90d traces
   - Retention: $0.065 / GB-month
   - Tracing: $0.035 / ingested-span-equivalent (approx $0.62 / GB-month)
   - Dashboards: $20 / editor seat; bundle price available for >=10 seats
   - Minimum 3-month commitment recommended

3) Enterprise visibility bundle — 365d logs + 365d traces + Advanced Dashboards
   - Retention: $0.045 / GB-month (quantization/compaction applied for long-tail cold data)
   - Tracing: $0.025 / ingested-span-equivalent (approx $0.45 / GB-month)
   - Dashboards: Unlimited embeds under a bundle; seat discount for >=25 seats
   - Requires 12-month commit for quoted pricing; eligible for early-adopter credit below

Early-adopter / pilot credit proposals:
- Pilot credit: 25% credit applied to the first full billing month of the pilot for Starter/Production tiers if signed within 30 days.
- Expansion credit: If Telestack converts to Enterprise bundle and increases commit by >=2x within first 6 months, Redwood will issue a one-time additional credit equal to 10% of the first 3 monthly invoices (applied as account credit).

Notes/clarifications:
- Tracing billing can be toggled to a flat GB-month model for predictability; Ben can provide the GB equivalence if you prefer simple invoicing.
- Dashboards: we can do per-embed or a capped-embed model. Embeds are preferable if you have many customer-facing dashboards.

I'll attach the sample invoice scenarios and our SLA addendum. If this looks directionally correct we'll prepare a short SOW and a DocuSign for the pilot. When are you free this week for a 30-min alignment?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Tessa — this is perfect, thanks. A couple quick clarifications from procurement and SRE:
- Can you clarify whether the 25% pilot credit stacks with a one-time onboarding credit (you mentioned waiving 2 weeks of retention fees for Starter)? We'd prefer the biggest up-front credit to cover the transition effort.
- On tracing: we favor a flat GB-month model for predictability; if you can convert those rates to GB-month numbers that makes the procurement review much faster.
- Regarding dashboards: can you provide a short example of the per-embed contract language (limits, throttling) — procurement is wary of burst billing.

If you can put those three clarifications in a short email we can get internal approval to move the pilot forward.

Thanks,
Amy

Amy — quick follow with the GB equivalences and contract language samples. I also attached a spreadsheet that maps your ingest estimate to example bills under each tier (usage-breakdown.xlsx).

Short answers:
- Pilot credit stacking: yes — we can stack the 25% pilot credit with the 2-week onboarding waiver for the Starter tier, up to a maximum credit value equal to 40% of the first month invoice. We typically cap stacking to avoid open-ended concessions.
- Tracing to GB-month mapping: using your ingest profile, 1M spans ≈ 60MB compressed on average. At your current rates that maps to approximately $0.70–$0.82 / GB-month depending on span cardinality. We can lock a flat $0.75 / GB-month for the pilot for predictability.
- Dashboard per-embed language (plain English): Embeds are billed per active embedded dashboard instance per month. We allow burst reads within a generous quota (250k hits/day per embed) before throttling; overage is billed at $0.02 per 1k extra queries. We'll provide concrete quota numbers in the SOW.

If Telestack wants a stronger onboarding concession we can offer a one-time $5k onboarding credit if you sign the pilot SOW by end of next week.

Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
